_comment: "Destroy this: You may add AN ACTION CARD FROM YOUR ARSENAL to the active chain link as a defending card." It was SELECT_FROM_REF over a ref "arsenal" that no effect sets, with its filter as a dict it does not read and a target 'chain_link_defense' it does not read either -- so nothing was selected and nothing was added. ADD_DEFEND is the effect that does this, and it added the SOURCE card only; it now takes the canonical object target, because this card adds a DIFFERENT object.
